properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Bernalillo County in central New Mexico...
Northwestern Valencia County in central New Mexico...
Southwestern Sandoval County in north central New Mexico...
Northeastern Cibola County in west central New Mexico...
East Central McKinley County in west central New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 615 AM MDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1207 AM MDT, very heavy rain that fell over the region
Thursday evening will allow high flows to persist in area
arroyos, creeks, and streams with large areas of standing water
and lowland flooding likely. Rainfall amounts ranged from 1 to 4
inches across the region with more localized heavy rainfall
expected overnight.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Laguna Pueblo, Marquez, Cebolletita, Mesita, New Laguna, Cubero,
San Fidel, Skyline-Ganipa, McCartys and Acoma Pueblo. Tributaries
leading into the Rio San Jose and Rio Puerco will also be
impacted.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 23 at 1:03AM CDT until October 23 at 9:00PM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
properties.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM NOON TO 8 PM MDT FRIDAY DUE TO
WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR SLOPE AND BOWMAN COUNTIES...

.Very warm and breezy conditions are expected across southwest North
Dakota this afternoon into early this evening. In far southwest North
Dakota, afternoon relative humidities are expected to drop to 15 to
20 percent, with winds around 20 mph and gusts to 40 mph. Therefore a
Red Flag Warning has been issued for Bowman and Slope counties in far
southwest North Dakota.

The National Weather Service in Bismarck ND has issued a Red Flag
Warning.

* AFFECTED AREA...Slope and Bowman.

* TIMING...From noon to 8 PM MDT Friday.

* WINDS...South winds around 20 mph with gusts to 40 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 19 to 25 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong winds,
low relative humidity and warm temperatures can contribute to extreme
fire behavior.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Colorado...

San Juan River at Pagosa Springs affecting Archuleta County.

For the San Juan River...including Pagosa Springs, Bluff...Major
flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...San Juan River at Pagosa Springs.

* WHEN...Until late Friday night.

* IMPACTS...At 14.5 feet, Water has reached the foundations of some
homes in the San Juan River Ranch northeast of Pagosa Springs.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:00 PM MDT Thursday the stage was 13.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 8.5 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 11:00 PM MDT Thursday was 13.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river will rise to 15.0 feet late tonight. It will
then fall below flood stage tomorrow evening to 8.0 feet Saturday
evening. It will rise to 8.1 feet Sunday morning. It will then
fall again and remain below flood stage.
- Flood stage is 10.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.5
feet on 06/29/1927.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
